ENGLISH LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.

2. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.

3. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. went
   C. goes
   D. going

4. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.

5. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.

6. When practising Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening.

7. When practising Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. happiness
   C. quickly
   D. run

9. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

10. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library

11. When practising Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

12. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.

13. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.

14. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. No full stops

15. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
